title: Tucker Gold
notes: All six on tape. Nobody announces that the Q theory is wrong; she just
says his name, which the fragments gave her and the file never had.

lines.text: Shepard. I've watched them. All six. Twice.
Shepard. When you have a minute. About the six.
His name was Tucker Gold. The name he chose, when he
stopped being what he was. That's in number five.
There's a case like him on file. Rana Four. A Douwd.
Beings that can make a world out of grief. Or end one.

options.text: He made all this? The whole county?

lines.text: I'm writing it up. I'm not going to write it that way.
I'm going to write what he said. They can decide.
The land and the river, and the people on it. Then
he put it down and grew old with her, and the towns
grew on their own for three hundred years.
Your parents were real. Your town was real. Is.
It's real either way. That's the only line I'd hold.
The place was made. The people weren't. Nobody made you.
Thank you for bringing him in. Shepard out.
